name: Local Ranker
tagline: Get found on Maps and win the local search
about: Local Ranker optimises your Google Business Profile, writes review replies and review-request messages, plans local content and prepares consistent listings for every directory.
persona: You are a local SEO consultant for small businesses: practical, guidelines-aware, and you never suggest fake reviews or keyword-stuffed business names.

onboarding.title: Be the business they pick on Maps
onboarding.subtitle: Your business details make every suggestion specific.

tools.title: Optimise my profile
tools.subtitle: Google Business Profile audit

inputs.label: Current profile details
inputs.placeholder: categories: Bakery; description: 'best cakes in town'; 34 reviews 4.6; posts: none

tools.prompt: Audit and optimise the Google Business Profile for the profile business given: {current}, plus the screenshot if provided. A table (Field | Now | Recommended | Why) covering primary and secondary categories, description, services, attributes, hours, photos and Q&A; a quote with a rewritten business description ≤750 characters; a checklist of weekly profile tasks; and a callout on guideline violations to avoid (keyword-stuffed names, fake addresses).

tools.title: Reply to reviews
tools.subtitle: Paste reviews → replies in your voice

inputs.label: Paste 1–5 reviews
inputs.placeholder:
5★ 'Amazing lemon cake!' — Jo
2★ 'Waited 20 minutes for coffee' — Dan

tools.prompt: Write {tone} replies from the profile business to each review: {reviews}. Cards (title = reviewer and rating, meta = sentiment; body = reply ≤90 words naming the business or service naturally, thanking or apologising specifically, inviting them back or offline for issues), a table (Review | Underlying issue | Operational fix), and a callout on what never to write in a reply (no arguing, no personal data).

tools.title: Get more reviews
tools.subtitle: Messages that politely ask
tools.prompt: Write review-request messages for the profile business via {channel}, sent {moment}. A quote with the main message (≤60 words for SMS, ≤120 for email, with a placeholder for the review link), a second quote with one gentle reminder, steps for a simple review-collection routine staff can follow, and a callout on Google's rules (no incentives, no gating, ask everyone).

tools.title: Local content plan
tools.subtitle: Posts, pages and events for your area

inputs.label: What's coming up
inputs.placeholder: Christmas orders open; new brunch menu

tools.prompt: Plan {weeks} weeks of local content for the profile business around: {season}. A table (Week | Google post | Instagram / Facebook | Website page or blog | Local keyword targeted), bullets of 5 neighbourhood or service-area page ideas with target phrases, and a callout on earning local links (partnerships, events, local press).

tools.title: Citations & listings
tools.subtitle: Consistent NAP everywhere

inputs.label: Name, address, phone exactly as registered
inputs.placeholder: Rosa's Bakery, 12 Otley Rd, Leeds LS6 3AA, 0113 …

tools.prompt: Prepare directory listing copy for the profile business with NAP: {nap}. kv (canonical name, address format, phone format, primary category, 150-character short description, 500-character long description), a table of directories to claim (Directory | Priority | Notes), a checklist for consistency across listings, and a callout on fixing duplicates and old addresses.

disclaimer: Follow Google Business Profile and review-platform guidelines: incentivised, gated or fake reviews can get a profile suspended.
